messages:
anya: Quick company-wide note: were deprecating the public sandbox tokens used in docs examples and samples on 2026-05-15. :warning:

anya: Reason: public tokens are a security and support risk for customers reusing example credentials. We're replacing them with a Private Docs Portal + short-lived example tokens (rotated per session).

matt: Will this break any live examples embedded in the docs site?

anya: No hard break. Were launching a compatibility layer: existing embedded samples will redirect to the new token flow automatically. However, self-hosted copies of docs that hardcode the tokens will need action.

soph: Docs plan: new Private Docs Portal (preview) at https://private-docs.redwood.ai with interactive sandboxes behind auth. Migration guide added: https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate-sandbox-tokens

matt: Admin CLI for orgs that still need a temporary exception?

anya: Yes. Org admins can request a time-limited exception during the 60-day window. CLI:
```bash
redwood admin sandbox-exception --org=my-org --until=2026-06-15
```

infra-bot: infra: created feature flag `docs.sandbox_token_sunset` for phased rollout.

docs-bot: docs/changeset created: changes/2026-03-23-sandbox-token-policy.md preview: https://docs.redwood.ai/changes/2026-03-23-sandbox-token-policy

sales-team-bot: Outreach: Email templates for customers prepared and queued (60d/30d/7d). Link: https://go.redwood.ai/sandbox-comms

anya: Action items:
- Docs: finish portal onboarding screens + add org-auth examples (soph)
- Eng: implement redirect compatibility layer and flag (matt)
- Support/Sales: targeted outreach for top 50 orgs (sales-team)

anya: We'll monitor `docs.sandbox_token_usage` metric and revisit after the 60-day window. Please ask questions here or ping me. END THREAD
